KILLARNEY PARISH (Please note that all Holy Week Ceremonies this year are taking place ONLY in St. Mary’s Cathedral so as to have a whole parish celebration.) TUESDAY MARCH 26TH THE CHRISM MASS at 7 pm Bishop Ray Browne will bless the oils to be used in the administration of the sacraments throughout the Diocese, in the year ahead. The priests will also renew their commitment to priesthood. All are welcome. HOLY THURSDAY MARCH 28TH ST. MARY’S CATHEDRAL 10.30 am Morning Prayer 7 pm Mass of the Lord’s Supper, . Silent Adoration following Mass until 10pm. A directed Holy Hour 10pm - 11pm. Adoration will conclude at 11pm. GOOD FRIDAY MARCH 29TH Celebrating the Sacrifice of Jesus on the Cross for our salvation. A Day of Fast and Abstinence. ST. MARY’S CATHEDRAL 10.30 am Morning Prayer. 3.00 pm Solemn Liturgy of the Lord’s Passion. Confessions 4pm - 6pm, 8pm - 9pm. 9pm Stations of the Cross with Confessions afterwards. HOLY SATURDAY MARCH 30TH The Church, as it were, by the tomb, quietly awaiting the Resurrection. 10.30 am Morning Prayer in the Cathedral. Confessions 12 noon - 2pm in the Cathedral. 8pm Easter Vigil with Bishop Ray and Concelebrants in St. Mary’s Cathedral. EASTER SUNDAY MARCH 31ST The Lord is Risen, the Light of Christ has come into the world. Allelu Masses at the usual times to celebrate the Lord’s Resurrection St. Mary’s Cathedral : 8 am 10.30 am and 12 Noon. Church of the Resurrection : 11am. Church of the Holy Spirit Muckross : 9.30am. FRANCISCAN FRIARY CONFESSION TIMES: MONDAY 25TH - THURSDAY 28TH 10.30 am – 12.30 pm; and 3pm— 5 pm HOLY THURSDAY—MARCH 28TH Morning Prayer: 10am Mass of the Lord’s Supper - 8pm Night Prayer at 11.45pm (Friary Oratory) Confessions 10.30am— 12.30 pm 3pm— 5pm GOOD FRIDAY—MARCH 29TH Morning Prayer: 10am Stations of the Cross at 12 noon Confessions 10.30am-11.30am, Solemn Liturgy of the Passion : - 3pm HOLY SATURDAY-MARCH 30TH Morning Prayer: 10am Confessions 10.30am – 12.30 pm & 3pm-5pm Easter Vigil: - 9pm EASTER SUNDAY –MARCH 31ST Mass at usual times: 8.30 am 10 am 11.30 am (There will be no Holy Hour ) Pls note No Confessions Easter Week Confessions will resume on Saturday 6th of April 10.30am— 11.30. am & 4pm, - 5pm

Mass for the Deceased of the Past Year , On Thursday the 19th of November 7pm, we will remember in a special way all our faithful departed who have gone to their eternal rest during the last year.
Relatives and friends are warmly invited to attend this Memorial Mass during which a candle will be lit for each of the departed and their names will be remembered in prayer.
You are welcome to then take the candle home.
